# PARAMETERS.md — every tunable in JSTACK

**Generated by `tools/gen-parameters.mjs` on every `pnpm codemap`. Do not edit.**
The table it reads is `jstack-app/data/parameters.ts`; the values live on the server
(`GET /parameters`), and the range published here is the range the server enforces —
a `PUT` outside it is a `422 { field: "value" }`.

**Josh changes a value** in Settings › Security, which renders one control per row below.
**The EA never writes one.** It raises a card with `POST /parameters/propose`, and
approving that card is what applies the value — with the same ten-second undo as every
other decision. Answering Never records the refusal so the EA can read it and stop asking.

| Key | What it does | Default | Range | Read by | The EA asks with |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lock.afterMinutes` | **Lock after** — How long JSTACK waits with no interaction before locking again. The timer keeps counting while the tab is in the background. | `10` | 1 – 60 minutes | `lib/autoLock.ts` | `POST /parameters/propose { key, value, reason }` → a decision card on Needs you |
| `lock.lockOnHideTouch` | **Lock a phone the moment it is put down** — On a phone or tablet, leaving the app or locking the screen locks JSTACK at once rather than waiting for the timer. Desktops never lock on a tab switch. | `true` | on / off | `lib/autoLock.ts` | `POST /parameters/propose { key, value, reason }` → a decision card on Needs you |
| `tasks.rangeDays` | **Task window** — How many days the Next and Last presets span on List, Board and Gantt. The chip reads the number back to you. | `90` | 7 – 365 days | `components/tasks/RangeChip.tsx`, `components/tasks/RangeDialog.tsx`, `data/mock/handlers/tasks.ts` | `POST /parameters/propose { key, value, reason }` → a decision card on Needs you |
| `files.recentDays` | **Keep recent files for** — How long this device keeps the details of a file you opened — its name, where it lives and a preview — so Find can answer without the network. Never the file itself. | `14` | 1 – 90 days | `lib/recentFiles.ts` | `POST /parameters/propose { key, value, reason }` → a decision card on Needs you |
| `mic.autoStopSeconds` | **Stop listening after** — How long the microphone stays open with nothing said before it closes itself. | `60` | 15 – 300 seconds | `stores/mic.ts` | `POST /parameters/propose { key, value, reason }` → a decision card on Needs you |
| `search.maxResults` | **Search results** — How many matches Find asks for at a time. | `50` | 10 – 200 | `data/mock/search.ts` | `POST /parameters/propose { key, value, reason }` → a decision card on Needs you |

## Adding one

1. A row in `jstack-app/data/parameters.ts` (the key joins `ParameterKey` in `data/types.ts`;
   `pnpm check` fails until it has a row).
2. Nothing else. The handler validates from the row, Settings › Security renders from the row,
   and this page regenerates from the row.
3. Read it with `currentParameter("your.key")` from `stores/parameters.ts`, and add that file
   to the row's `usedBy` — `tests/unit/parameters.test.ts` opens it and checks the key is there.
